recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見體積巨大、多核或多葉核的間變性漿細胞，胞質豐富灰藍（A），插圖箭頭指出核內包涵體；切片中多個腫瘤細胞核內有淡染、圓形空泡狀的核內包涵體（Dutcher bodies，B 箭頭），符合帶 Dutcher 小體的間變型漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Panel A: markedly enlarged, pleomorphic plasma cells with multilobated or multiple nuclei and abundant blue-gray cytoplasm
Coarse to open chromatin with visible nucleoli in anaplastic cells, admixed with more conventional plasma cells
Panel A inset: intranuclear inclusion (arrow) within a large neoplastic cell
Panel B: tissue section with multiple pale round intranuclear pseudoinclusions (Dutcher bodies, arrowheads), some cells containing several
Background of eosinophilic proteinaceous material and scattered tumor cells with prominent nucleoli
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate (A) shows numerous atypical plasma cells, including markedly enlarged anaplastic forms with multilobated or multiple nuclei, open chromatin, nucleoli and abundant basophilic cytoplasm; the inset highlights an intranuclear inclusion. The corresponding tissue section (B) shows pleomorphic tumor cells containing multiple pale, rounded intranuclear inclusions (arrowheads) consistent with Dutcher bodies. Findings are consistent with the anaplastic variant of plasma cell myeloma with Dutcher bodies; CD138, MUM1 and light-chain restriction studies are needed to confirm plasma cell lineage in such bizarre cells.

ddx.vs: Bizarre multinucleated cells can mimic metastasis, but these lack cohesion and would be CD138/MUM1 positive with light-chain restriction and cytokeratin/SOX10 negative.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei with granular pink cytoplasm and no perinuclear hof, and are CD61/CD42b positive.
Shows monomorphic immunoblastic cells, frequent EBER positivity and extramedullary presentation rather than giant multinucleated anaplastic plasma cells with Dutcher bodies.
Dutcher bodies are also common, but the infiltrate consists of small lymphocytes and mature plasmacytoid cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.
